business_quality.justification: Revenue, operating income and net income all rose every year: revenue $0.49B to $0.67B, operating income $0.13B to $0.22B, net income $0.11B to $0.20B. Operating margin 33.2% on a subscription model where customers renew annually. Small but consistently profitable, which is unusual in security software - most peers at this size are still loss-making. Deducted because the absolute scale is modest ($0.67B revenue) and growth is a steady 13%, not exceptional.

competitive_advantage.justification: Vulnerability management is sticky in a specific way: the agent is deployed across a customer's entire estate, the scan history becomes the compliance audit trail, and auditors expect continuity year to year. Ripping it out means re-baselining everything. But the moat is narrower than it looks - Tenable, Rapid7, Wiz and the cloud providers' native tooling all compete directly, and larger platform vendors increasingly bundle vulnerability scanning into broader security suites. Bundling is the real threat to a point solution.

catalysts.justification: The weakest catalyst set among this session's finalists, and I am scoring it honestly rather than inventing one. There is no dated event that re-rates this stock. What exists is mechanical: a share count down 10.5% over the window through genuine buybacks, and steady mid-teens revenue growth. That compounds value but it does not catch anyone's attention. A company growing 13% and guiding to 13% delivers exactly what is expected.

risk_reward.justification: Base +16% against a bear of -27%. The reverse DCF gives modest comfort: the price implies 12.3% annual free-cash-flow growth against 15.2% delivered - a real cushion, but a thin one. At 31.1x earnings there is not much room for disappointment, and the upside requires the multiple to hold rather than expand. Positive expectancy, unremarkable asymmetry.

management.justification: The clearest capital allocation of this session's candidates: share count down 10.5% through sustained buybacks while margins expanded, so per-share growth is real and amplified rather than manufactured to disguise a decline. Consistent profitability at a scale where competitors burn cash. Withheld one point because sustained buybacks at 30x-plus earnings are only accretive if the business keeps compounding - the same discipline would be worth more at a lower multiple.
